text.en: Clients describe the salon team as attentive, patient, and welcoming across routine visits. Reviewers note that groomers take time to comfort anxious pets, though one client expressed frustration that the salon enforced a strict appointment cancellation fee despite a medical emergency.

Dog owners frequently praise the team for handling nervous, rescue, and reactive pets with genuine care. Several clients recount groomers turning off noisy equipment or letting pets explore beforehand to minimize stress, leaving animals relaxed and happy during their visits.

Pet parents highlight neat haircuts and tidy coats, noting that difficult coats are managed with thorough care. Reviewers appreciate returning home with freshly bathed dogs that look well-groomed, with one owner noting that styling significantly exceeded expectations.

q.en: How does the salon handle reactive or nervous dogs?

a.en: Reviewers emphasize that staff members take extra time to calm nervous dogs, introduce equipment gradually, and accommodate reactive behavior.

q.en: Are retail food items available for purchase?

a.en: Yes, clients note that the shop stocks raw diet foods, healthy treats, and specialized nutritional products for dogs.

q.en: What is the salon's policy regarding missed appointments?

a.en: Reviews note that the business enforces a strict cancellation and no-show fee, even when appointments are missed due to personal emergencies.
